summary: Closed out the correction review for the two live accounts that the narrowed drift knowledge affects, and answered the gaps the controller registered for them. Nothing new was executed; the turn reads knowledge e65d63f4057d4c5bbe8390ac06b30fce-knowledge-2 revision 2 against the trim child's and the snapshot child's current accounts and against the newest executed receipt 0b9c22ae5fb043588aa7efa3ad009b25. The trim child keeps its conclusion and now re-reads that knowledge use at revision 2 with the explanation that only the retained half (the reported accepted index drifting one index per re-synchronization round, which inflates the recorded minimum the trim bound derives from) is what its witness needs, and its gap for a request below an over-compacted index carries partial progress and stays open: the in-cluster route is executed in the sibling receipt and ends silently with a complete but empty snapshot installed on the lagging replica (compacted 8 with a zero-id snapshot, replica left at accepted 10 / decided 10 reading two entries instead of six, no panic), the trim path itself cannot produce such a request because its bound is the minimum recorded accepted index, the abort seen in the lineage belongs to the public snapshot call on a NoSnapshot instance and is recorded under its own question, and the direct-range-read, store-level-trim and truthful-peer routes remain unexecuted, so those two review gaps are marked resolved while that one is left unresolved. The snapshot child likewise keeps its conclusion, gains the executed lagging-replica variant as the form its variant (iv) predicts, re-reads the drift knowledge at revision 2, and adds the newest knowledge entry for the below-compacted re-synchronization; its peer-side variant stays argued from the derivation and is stated as such. Both accounts were validated as interpretation successors for their own investigations and experiments, with counterevidence and limitations updated to distinguish what is now executed from what is still derived. Incomplete: the parent's own knowledge-correction gap ebbec352695d43beb398bb1b239cda41-gap-5 was not answered this turn because answering it needs a rewrite of the long parent account, and the forwarded-compaction, direct-range-read and forwarded-Compaction-to-NoSnapshot variants still need harness work.
